plugins.name: compliance-pages
plugins.description: Generate the legal/compliance pages every website needs — Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, Support, Contact — plus a compliant cookie consent banner, and conditionally an accessibility statement and refund/shipping policies. Grounded in an actual scan of the codebase and right-sized to what the site really does.

plugins.name: json-ld
plugins.description: Implement, fix, and deepen schema.org structured data as JSON-LD — including WordPress (Yoast/Rank Math/WooCommerce-aware) and Shopify Liquid themes. Discovers every entity worth marking up by scanning data models and routes, verifies every type and property against the live schema.org release and Google rich-results docs (never model memory), wires each value to the page's real data flow, and validates against the rendered HTML.
